Evidence: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh was sworn in as a Judge of the Kerala High Court on July 21, 2023. He was transferred from the Allahabad High Court following the Supreme Court Collegium's recommendation, which rejected his request to be transferred to nearby states. His appointment was notified by the Central Government. Justice Singh had previously served as an Additional Judge of the Allahabad High Court since September 22, 2017, and took oath as a permanent Judge on September 6, 2019. The swearing-in ceremony was live streamed on the Kerala High Court's official website (Source 1).
Justification: The retrieved evidence clearly states that Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh was sworn in as a Judge of the Kerala High Court on July 21, 2023, confirming the claim. It details his transfer from the Allahabad High Court and the Collegium's decision regarding his request for transfer to other states. This information directly corroborates the core assertion of the claim, thus supporting it.
